verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust server-rendering web and UI framework (Axum routing, components, Markdown render targets). It is not an agent or tool-using runtime, so plugging MCP servers in as a client is the wrong role for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Proa itself acting as an MCP client: its AI-native features are AGENTS.md scaffolding, Markdown docs routes and llms-full.txt, which serve agents rather than consume tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
